description: Shared planner-content corpus: every non-floor subject's rules and edge shapes, replayed by both runtimes' full validator entry points.

conventions.content: base with each edit applied in order; 'at' is a path of object keys (strings) and array indices (numbers); 'remove' deletes the key, otherwise 'value' is set (a new key is appended)
conventions.raw: when present, the literal content string replaces base and edits; the frontend, which takes parsed content, records it as skipped
conventions.version: gameData.contentVersion unless the case says otherwise
conventions.title: 'Corpus' unless the case sets it; null means no title
conventions.stages: draft and publish unless the case says otherwise
conventions.results: expected: each case's 'expected' holds, per stage it runs, the ordered (code, path) list both runtimes return, ordered by path then code, with the path rendered as ContentPath renders it (empty for the root); each runtime's replay asserts it, the frontend skipping raw cases; each runtime also writes its actual lists per case per stage when its output variable is set

gameData.egoMaxThreadspinNote: 20103 is a known E.G.O with no ceiling
gameData.egoGiftThemePacksNote: empty list means affordable for every pack
